dependency_notes.chromium/add_missing_lock_annotation.pat: Omitted from dependency series: upstream Environment::Create already has EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED(GetLock()).
dependency_notes.chromium/av_add_ability_to_get_native_gp: Preserve frame-scoped audio authorization and resolve every pending RestrictionTarget resolver with the Discord capture token.
dependency_notes.chromium/fix_validate_locale_exists_befo: Use upstream CheckAndResolveLocale fallback and retain Discord empty-localization guard.
dependency_notes.ffmpeg/fix_openh264_opaque_for_bframes.p: Keep upstream decoder NULL cleanup, flush handler and failed-reinitialization guard; add Discord packet metadata caching without duplicating the upstream flush callback.
dependency_notes.ffmpeg/roll_ffmpeg.patch: Replaced in the dependency series with roll_ffmpeg_linux_x64.patch generated from the current patched FFmpeg sources. Non-Linux GN lists are preserved; only Linux x64 codec configuration is qualified.

upstream_equivalents.build/zip.py: Preserve upstream WER packaging and static-ANGLE stub exclusions for the Linux build.
upstream_equivalents.lib/browser/api/web-contents.ts: The deviceScaleFactor property moves into the native WebContents template, matching the new upstream accessor layout.
upstream_equivalents.lib/sandboxed_renderer/api/module-list.t: Upstream removed this module list; the shared renderer module list already carries the Discord binding.
upstream_equivalents.patches/chromium/cherry-pick-69403d85b78: The removed upstream patch only received a mail-subject formatting edit in the Discord delta; no executable change is omitted.
upstream_equivalents.shell/app/electron_crash_reporter_client: Upstream has its own newer WER registration/path implementation; retain it. WER is not used by Linux.
Keep the matching upstream WER declarations; the older Discord declaration is superseded.
upstream_equivalents.shell/browser/api/electron_api_browser_w: Keep upstream cppgc Persistent/WeakPersistent members and tracing, replacing the older v8 Global/base WeakPtr ownership model.
upstream_equivalents.shell/common/gin_converters/std_converte: Upstream propagates MaybeLocal conversion failure; retain that behavior instead of forcing ToLocalChecked globally.
